description: Correctness #425 offline1.22/player3 real-save XP multiplier, hourly gain and ETA. Maps6/31 exercise education0/positive and all5 rank role effects; maps6/53/51/1 exercise Trader+Commander, Trader, Commander, no gain. Only Commander movable assignments exist; Knight/Priest positive gain and Militia upgrade17 highest-rank/strict-tie/half-Military behavior remain source-only. Shop77 is absent, returns undefined, and its >=1 guard is inactive; omit a numeric constant comparison and cover guard through full multipliers. Education coefficient10 and glorified saved state are not parameter calculations. No new tolerance; only accepted threshold bounds propagate into ETA.

extractions.label: xp_hourly_6_0
extractions.expression: (() => { const call = (name,t,i) => idleon.callFunction("RoyalG",name,t,i); const rows = idleon.getAttr("RoyalMaps"); const g = idleon.getAttr("RoyalG"); const row = rows[6]; let gain = 0; if (0 < 2) { if (call("HasOutpost",6,0) === 1 && row.length > 2) gain = call("BarExpRate",0,6) * call("TotalUnitsz",6,1); } for (let w = 0; w < 8; w++) { const roles = g[6+2*w] || []; const maps = g[7+2*w] || []; for (let u = 0; u < roles.length; u++) { if (Number(maps[u]) !== 6) continue; const role = Number(roles[u]); if (role >= 5 && role - 3 === 0) gain += call("BarExpRate",role-3,6); else if (role === 4 && row.length !== 1 && call("ArmoryUpgBonus",17,0) >= 1) { let selected = 0; let best = -1; for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) { const level = call("OutpostEXPrank",6,t); if (level > best) { best = level; selected = t; } } if (selected === 0) gain += call("BarExpRate",3,6) / 2; } } } return gain; })()
